title: Calm Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan for approval · calm by default · nothing built yet
approval: Build plan approved: calm by default

short.lead: You approved the Calm test site and it is merged (pull request #197). This plan builds it into the real app in seven steps, each its own GitHub issue under #198. One thing the test site never drew: where the Projects screen's tools go. That is the one choice below.
short.hint: Tap a step for what it builds and what it replaces.
items: The side menu becomes one wide column with the Focus Deck name, full-size screen rows and Settings at the bottom; the jotter lines up with the content. Phones keep today's bottom bar.

items.alt: The test site's wide side menu beside the Board
items.caption: The frame from the test site.

items: One tab, one toolbar, cards in groups (#200)
Up next, In progress and Done this week become tabs; Find, Project and Filter sit above them; seven cards then Show more; the move buttons replace dragging between columns.

after.alt: The calm Board with one tab

items.caption: Left: the Board today. Right: the approved Board.

items: Title and status always show; Notes, Priority and due date, Labels, Subtasks and Linked tasks fold into rows. Changes save as they are made.

items.alt: Task details with five folded rows
items.caption: Task details, every row closed.

items: Card colour by category, priority, date or label (#202)
Each card shows one chip and takes its colour from the first item in the Card colour list that the task has.

items.alt: Cards coloured by priority and date after reordering
items.caption: Cards after moving Due date and Priority up.

items: Every setting in a folded row, plus Comfort (#203)
Every setting on the Settings page shows its name and value and opens on a tap. A new Comfort group adds movement, softer colours, card colour, cards at once and the past-its-date colour.
Literal words (#204) and the Sort fixes (#205)

'Bin it' becomes 'Delete', 'Stick on flags' becomes 'Add labels', and so on. Sort gets back right-click colour on cards, notes that scroll above the tray lip, and step headers that say why they are locked.
Where the Projects screen's tools go, then approve the plan.
Answer the choice below, then tap Copy my reply and send what it gives you.

The Projects screen holds tools the test site never drew a place for: new project, the GitHub repo link, rename, colour, category, reorder and delete. Taking it out now would drop them.

changes.caption: Today's Projects screen and its tools.

choices: What should happen to the Projects screen in this build?
Keep it as it is for now
Nothing is lost. A calm 'Project details' gets its own test site next, and the Board takes over once you approve it.
Board takes over now, project tools go in a Project details panel
Picking a project in the Board's Project menu opens Project details beside the list. I would design it while building, without a test site first.
Board takes over now, project tools move into Settings
Settings gets a Projects row listing every project with its tools. Quick, but far from the tasks it affects.
The test site took Projects out of the menu but showed nowhere for its tools, so building that part now would mean designing it without your review.

wrapup.summary: Seven steps that turn the approved Calm test site into the real app.
wrapup.changing: Changed: the side menu, the Board, the task panel (now Task details), card colours, the Settings page and the app's wording. New: Comfort settings and the Card colour list. Kept: Focus, Sort's three parts, ties, GitHub sync, and for now the Projects screen.
wrapup.blocking: Your answer on the Projects screen and your approval of this plan. No app code changes until you approve.
wrapup.next: After approval I build the steps in order (#199 to #205) on the branch AjsAgent/calm-build, check each in a browser at desktop and phone width, and open one pull request for your QA.
